title: Gehenna
lead: Gehenna is the Greek form of the Hebrew Ge Hinnom, the Valley of Hinnom just south of Jerusalem, where kings of Judah burned children as offerings (2 Kings 23:10; Jeremiah 7:31). The prophets made it a place of judgment, and by Jesus' time Jews used the name for the place of fiery punishment after death. Most English Bibles translate it "hell."
